label: default agent • create a folder watcher (declarative apply)
query: Watch my ~/Downloads folder and organize new files into subfolders by type whenever something lands there.
notes: Watchers require a custom agent (by name); the declarative document can carry BOTH the `agents:` entry and the `watchers:` entry in ONE apply — the exact multi-domain composition the consolidation exists for. A model that applies them in two steps is equally correct. Pins the Downloads path and the watchers section. The applier validates the directory exists, so on eval hosts without ~/Downloads the call still counts for selection scoring.
